request.description: Public unauthenticated readiness check for the AMLOK API. HTTP 200 with status ok means the API can accept requests; HTTP 503 with status unavailable means it cannot. No borrower or tenant data is exposed. This is a point-in-time check, not confirmation that a job completed, an integration is current, or every product is operational.

request.description: Public unauthenticated summary of AMLOK service availability. A successful HTTP 200 means the status report was retrieved; inspect the overall and per-service status to understand availability. unknown means a current state cannot be confirmed and must not be treated as operational. updated_at identifies the observation time; do not treat stale or unreachable status as healthy. Provider-specific freshness and account connection errors are separate from AMLOK service availability. This response contains no internal infrastructure identifiers or customer data.
